text:
The Juniper planning summary for 3–10 November sets corrected values that supersede earlier drafts, including quota batch_size 900 and checkout ttl_s 360. Hard rules prohibit search depending on feed, sync depending on media, and any dependency from session to ledger or from archive to ingest. Checkout and sync cannot share a worker, nor can export and feed, but ingest and checkout may, and so may shipping and upload. Catalog/shipping and billing/checkout must run on separate workers.

Required ordering: metrics before reports, feed before scheduler, quota before session, and checkout before shipping.

Ownership: media on alpha; alerts, inventory, and catalog on beta; reports and profile on gamma; metrics and ledger on delta.

Retries: feed is fixed at 9 and sync at 8. Pricing is set at 6 per client requirement, and if feed exceeds 6, shipping must be 1 or less.

Open items: a month-end security review, a budget review moved to next Thursday, and a suggested client demo.
